title: \textbf{Hodge on $X \times X$ Implies Grothendieck's Lefschetz Standard Conjecture B: Lean 4 Formalization

claims.statement: Let $\Lambda : \mathrm{Class}$ represent the K\"unneth/correspondence class of the inverse Lefschetz operator on $X \times X$. Under the hypotheses $\mathrm{h\Lambda} : \mathrm{IsHodge}(\Lambda)$ and $\mathrm{hHC} : \forall \gamma,\, \mathrm{IsHodge}(\gamma) \to \mathrm{IsAlgebraic}(\gamma)$ on $X \times X$: \[ \mathrm{IsHodge}(\Lambda) \;\wedge\; \mathrm{HodgeOnProduct} \implies \mathrm{LefschetzB}(\Lambda). \]
claims.title: \texttt{hodge\_on\_product\_implies\_lefschetz\_B}
